name: com.tencent.timpush.fcm.GoogleFCMMsgService
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Google Firebase Cloud Messaging adapter receives messaging callbacks. When Google issues a new registration token, it sends the token to Tencent Cloud IM's push connector.
disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Firebase token updates through this service, so its Google-backed offline-push registration stops refreshing.
